IF OBJECT_ID('Temp.Logs', 'U') IS NOT NULL
  DROP TABLE Temp.Logs; 
 
 
CREATE TABLE [Temp].[Logs](
 [SourceSystemCode] [nvarchar](150) NULL,
 [LogMessage] [nvarchar](150) NULL,
 [StartTime] [datetime] NULL,
 [EndTime] [datetime] NULL,
 [MachineName] [nvarchar](150) NULL,
 [ProductVersion] [nvarchar](150) NULL,
 [VersionBuild] [int] NULL,
 [VersionGUID] [nvarchar](150) NULL,
 [VersionMajor] [int] NULL,
 [VersionMinor] [int] NULL
) ON [PRIMARY]

Select getdate() as RunLoadDate
, IDENT_CURRENT ('Control.LoadSummary') as RunLoadId


/*

 Select getdate() as RunLoadDate
, newid() as RunLoadId


*/

select BatchId_DW =max(cast(  isnull(batchid,0) +1 as integer))
from(
select max(batchid) BatchId
from control.Batch

Union 
select 0
)a
where BatchId is not null

Truncate table Temp.[LoadSummary1]
Truncate table Temp.[LoadSummary2]
Truncate table Temp.[LoadSummary3]
Truncate table Temp.[LoadSummary4]
Truncate table Temp.[LoadSummary5]
Truncate table Temp.[LoadSummary6]

;
